observations.body: The sent disciples heal and announce nearness in receptive towns, while rejected towns receive the same nearness statement with a public sign.

payload.posture: Read Luke 10:1–16 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the sent disciples heal and announce nearness in receptive towns, while rejected towns receive the same nearness statement with a public sign. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
